# Multi-Family Office

Turn your financial complexity into your greatest asset.

As an entrepreneurial, enterprising family, your financial needs are complex and involve numerous strategic and detailed decisions. You may feel like you need cohesive integration between different tax, legal and wealth disciplines. Perhaps you’re in the middle, orchestrating everything, which takes precious time and resources.

[![Aspiriant's Multi-Family Office](https://aspiriant.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/aspiriant_multi_family_office_thumb.webp)\\
Read More\\
**A Multi-Generational Affair**](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#story)

[Questions to Ask](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#Questions%20to%20Ask-0) [Client Case Study](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#Client%20Case%20Study-1)

### Ask these questions when hiring a multi-family office:

[Q.\\
Are all the components of my family’s financials being managed in an integrated, cohesive way by experienced financial professionals?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
Are all the pieces in-line with family goals and legacy?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
Am I using the right investment strategies across various entities?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
How much should I leave to my children?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
Are my children prepared to handle wealth and family responsibilities?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
How do you help me manage my family’s governance, taking into account values, education, generational differences and family meetings?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
Does this team have the credentials and in-house specialists in the right disciplines – tax, legal, investment – to guide my family?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout) [Q.\\
Can you pay my invoices and create reporting to help take the load off and leave me informed?](https://aspiriant.com/multi-family-office/#footer-callout)

* * *

![Aspiriant Multi Family Office](https://aspiriant.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/aspiriant_multi_family_office.webp)

### A multi-generational affair

Anne and Rob started working with Aspiriant’s Exclusive Family Office team as Rob was getting ready to retire from a large public company after a long career as a senior executive. Though the family had accumulated an estate worth over $100 million, 70% of their wealth was concentrated in one stock and they had never carved out time to create a meaningful estate plan and they had yet to execute on charitable giving goals that were very important to them. On top of it all, they also had concerns around how their wealth would impact future generations.

First, our Exclusive Family Office team worked with Anne and Rob to put a long-term wealth plan in place to quantify the amount they could comfortably earmark for family and charity. Next, we developed a globally diversified portfolio in accordance with the couple’s long-term goals and values. Then, we turned our attention to creating an estate plan to support Rob and Anne’s goals of transferring assets to future generations and philanthropic planning.

While Rob and Anne were intellectually prepared to implement tax efficient estate planning strategies, it took some time for them to become emotionally comfortable with the idea of transferring the wealth they had worked so hard to accumulate.

In response, we started the estate planning process simply and only grew to sophisticated strategies over time. We encouraged the couple to make annual exclusion gifts to their children and grandchildren, without touching their lifetime gift-tax exemption. Next, we helped incorporate more powerful tools for tax savings into the couple’s strategy, including Grantor Retained Annuity Trusts, a Family Limited Partnership and a sale to a Defective Grantor Trust. Finally, to accomplish their philanthropic goals we established a Donor Advised Fund and contributed some of the concentrated stock Rob had accumulated to optimize the tax savings associated with the significant gift.

With their comprehensive wealth plan in place, Anne and Rob were eager to bring their adult children into the conversation. While they knew the time was right to bring the kids into the fold, they found it difficult to convey the essence of the legacy they wanted to create and so they turned to Aspiriant to help facilitate these important discussions. Our initial meeting with the children evolved into an ongoing relationship with multiple members of the next generation. In addition to discussing the level of family wealth during our meetings, we focus on the purpose of the wealth, the importance around being a responsible steward of the wealth, the “why” behind the various strategies that have been implemented and how the wealth can be used as a tool for positive impact during their lives.

Developing a relationship with the extended family was the cherry on top of a successful partnership between Aspiriant and Anne and Rob. Knowing that an integrated, well thought out plan that aligned with their goals and values had been put in place, we hope Anne and Rob felt a great sense of gratitude and relief. The work they had wanted to do for years was now being tended to on an ongoing basis and we believe a weight had been lifted.

_Important Disclaimer: This case study is presented as a hypothetical scenario and is intended for illustrative purposes only. It does not represent a specific client’s experience, but rather is meant to provide an example of Aspiriant’s process and methodology. An individual’s experience may vary based on his or her individual circumstances. There can be no assurance that similar results would be achieved in comparable situations. No portion of this case study is to be interpreted as a testimonial or endorsement of Aspiriant, and there is no way to ascertain whether a specific client would have been satisfied with their results._

# Family Office Services

For select families who seek a deeper, more comprehensive approach to managing their wealth across generations.

[Request a Consultation](https://hbwealth.com/request-a-consultation/)

## HB Wealth's Family Office Division takes our fee-only fiduciary advisory model to the next level through a uniquely personalized experience for select families who seek a more comprehensive approach to managing their wealth.

We understand that substantial wealth brings both opportunity and complexity. Our role as a multi-family office is to simplify your financial life to ensure that every detail is handled with care and precision. You no longer need to wonder if something’s falling through the cracks. We can become the leader of your extended professional team, working meticulously with your other advisors and family staff.

HB Wealth offers specialized, expert teams who have managed family offices and worked with family office clients for many years, currently serving more than 180 family office clients with an average total market value of approximately $100 million per client.\* With this extensive experience, we know that each family office client is unique, and we personalize and tailor our services and relationship to fit your needs.

\*The "Average Total Market Value per Family Office Client Relationship" reflects the arithmetic mean of the aggregate market value of assets under management and assets under advisement for Family Office client relationships as of March 31, 2026, divided by the total number of such client relationships on that date. Asset values vary significantly among clients, and the reported average does not represent the market value of any individual client relationship, nor is it indicative of the experience of any particular client. Market values fluctuate over time.

[Understanding Family Offices](https://hbwealth.com/insights-and-news/helpful-resources/understanding-family-offices/)

### HB Wealth’s Family Office Division Offers Clear Advantages

### Fee-Only Fiduciary Commitment

Unlike many firms, HB Wealth operates as an independent fee-only fiduciary. We are not focused on gathering your assets or selling you products. We offer flexible fee approaches for our family office clients that do not have to be based on assets under management. Our agenda is trying to help families get the best return for their investments in all aspects of their financial life.

[Learn More >](https://hbwealth.com/about-us/the-hb-wealth-difference/fee-only-fiduciary-commitment/)

### Consolidated Reporting

Most new family office clients come to us with stacks of statements across multiple managers and sometimes complicated spreadsheets that attempt to keep track of it all. We can bring everything together for you with a comprehensive report of all your investment assets, regardless of manager. We can track public and private investments, liquid and illiquid, contributions and distributions, in a simple reporting system that you can view online or in printed reports.

### Private Market Expertise

Many family office clients take advantage of opportunities in private equity, private debt, and private real estate. HB Wealth has over 30 years of private market investment experience and a dedicated in-house research team that thoroughly vets private market opportunities and selects managers we believe have the greatest potential to generate strong risk-adjusted returns for our clients. In addition, we are happy to vet outside investment opportunities that have been presented to your family. We can help you make decisions with confidence, and equally importantly, say “no” when the fit isn’t right.\*

[Learn More >](https://hbwealth.com/about-us/the-hb-wealth-difference/private-market-expertise/)

### Administrative Services

Our family office clients enjoy a level of service that allows them to spend less time on paperwork and more time enjoying their wealth and life. For those who choose to add it, we can provide bill pay services with customizable reporting and approvals for an additional fee.

[Learn More >](https://hbwealth.com/our-services/wealth-advisory-services/administrative-services/)

### Generational Guidance and Family Governance

We provide thoughtful guidance around family education, legacy conversations, and long-term planning to help guide children and grandchildren to make wise decisions regarding their wealth. From structuring and facilitating constructive family meetings to building a common vision, we can help you cultivate financial responsibility and shared values across generations.

### Multi-Family Office Scale. Single-Family Office Care.

HB Wealth's family office services can bring you the advantages of a dedicated family office, including the collaborative expertise of our specialist family office teams, without the burden or expense of building and managing one yourself. Our wealth strategists are on hand to guide your estate planning and multi-generational needs, and our advanced tax planning strategists can help with income and transfer tax guidance. Benefit from economies of scale while experiencing a concierge-level service that feels like your own dedicated family office.

[Understanding Family Offices >](https://hbwealth.com/insights-and-news/understanding-family-offices/)

### Estate and Trust Guidance Off the Clock

Our dedicated, full-time wealth strategists are former estate planning attorneys who can help you navigate complex trust and estate issues without racking up billable hours. From trustee selection to distribution structures to visualizing how wealth flows across generations, we bring clarity to the conversation and act as a true partner to your legal team as your plans evolve.

[Learn More >](https://hbwealth.com/our-services/wealth-advisory-services/estate-planning/)

### Philanthropy That Reflects Your Values

Family office clients often have a keen interest in giving back and their level of wealth allows them to make significant gifts or even consider a private foundation. HB Wealth helps families assess their options, navigate major gift discussions, and manage the philanthropy process aligned with the mission, vision, and values of the family.

## Interested in Learning More About Our Family Office Services?

[Request a Consultation](https://hbwealth.com/request-a-consultation/)

\*Past performance is not a guarantee of future results for any investment. Private market investments are not for every client. An individual must be qualified to invest in a private investment based on their net worth and/or other criteria, and they may qualify to invest in some private market investments while not be allowed to invest in other private market investments. Private market investments are not risk-free and there is no guarantee of achieving attractive performance compared to similar liquid investments. This material is not a recommendation, offer or solicitation to sell or purchase any security, and individuals should consult their own advisers before making any investment decisions. All investing involves risk.

# Family Office Services

We provide an experience that is different from the transactional nature of other firms. We take the time to understand each client’s situation, create a customized strategy, and execute with a level of excellence.

![](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/services-hero-696x290.jpg)

When we work together with you, the experience is personal, focused on your needs, and backed by decades of working with families. Our service approach isn’t about gathering your assets, but rather how we can provide you with the most holistic and transparent pathway to your family’s long-term success. We are here to help and to serve.

## What is a Family Office?

We understand that making the most of your wealth can sometimes feel challenging when burdened with day-to-day management. A family office can provide a wide range of services to manage wealth while promoting a family’s identity and character. By working with Tolleson as your family office, you benefit from working with an experienced, multi-disciplinary team.

## What We Offer

### Investment Management

With our view of the economic landscape and your family’s specific vision, we build a personalized investment portfolio aimed to meet your goals.1

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/investment-management/)

### Estate Planning

Good estate planning should be more than a plan that sits on a shelf. We work with you to create, implement, and monitor a plan that incorporates your family’s goals and long-term wishes.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/estate-planning/)

### Family Engagement

We support clients in building a foundation to help ensure an engaged, resilient, and thriving family for generations.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/family-engagement)

### Tax Planning and Strategy

Our in-house tax professionals help formulate proactive tax planning strategies and coordinate individual, trust, estate, and personal entity returns.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/tax-planning-and-strategy)

### Private Banking

We provide sophisticated services to conveniently support your family’s personal and business banking needs.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/private-banking/)

### Trustee and Estate Settlement

Through Tolleson Trust Company, we offer a full suite of services and have extensive experience working with family enterprises and integrating seamlessly with your estate plan.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/trustee-and-estate-settlement)

### Financial Reporting and Bill Pay

We offer comprehensive financial reporting and bill pay services to support your investment, tax, estate, and philanthropic plans.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/financial-reporting-and-bill-pay/)

### Philanthropy Services

By understanding the impact you want to make, our team can advise and execute on the best way to fulfill your charitable goals.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/philanthropy)

## What Makes Us Different?

#### Shared Experiences

Working with other families allows us to share our experience and knowledge with you. Our collaborative approach helps us implement complex and strategic planning.

#### Strategy

We understand that you have unique needs, and we use our in-depth discovery process to drive our relationship. Our wide breadth of services helps simplify complexities to provide you with a more holistic view into your overall financial situation.

#### Service-Focused

Our advisors are not compensated with sales commissions or portfolio performance incentives. We are focused on our goal to serve you, not to sell.

## Our Client Situations

Taking care of client families is an important mission we uphold every day. No matter the situation, our team is committed to working with you toward the best outcome for your goals.

![](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/T_GDW_people_J-2-1-e1675786631951-648x484.jpg)

Pre-Transaction Planning

When it comes time for entrepreneurs to sell their businesses, it can be difficult and emotional. Equipped with the knowledge and experience to walk business owners through the sale process, the team can help cover blind spots and anticipate what a client’s experience will look like both during and after the sale.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/insights-and-news/chief-experience-officer-royce-ramey-shares-five-things-business-owners-should-consider-before-selling-a-business/)

Values-Based Investing

What if your return on investment wasn’t just designed to increase your wealth? What if you could use your wealth to invest in organizations that also support the values that are most important to your family? Tolleson offers a wide range of values-based investing solutions for our clients across personal and charitable assets, interest areas, and asset types. We partner with our client families to create a customized portfolio that reflects their unique values.

[Learn More](https://www.tollesonwealth.com/services/values-based-investing/)

## Our Process

- ## Discover




Our thorough and in-depth discovery process gives you a full view of your financial picture.

- ## Analyze & Design




Because we take the time to understand your situation, we create a customized strategy aimed to fulfill your needs across multiple disciplines.

- ## Confirm




We confirm our plan with you in a manner that is realistic, informed, and well documented.

- ## Implement




Our implementation includes detailed execution and coordination.

- ## Monitor & Adjust




We provide the “care and feeding” of your plan, including ongoing monitoring and reporting.

Do you In-source and have the most control and personalization, but incur the cost and hassle of building your own team?

Or do you fully outsource, but lose control and customization?

# A Third Option: Co-Sourcing

#### Collaborating to build customized partnerships

Greycourt’s co-sourcing model offers ultra-high-net-worth families an alternative to traditional in-sourcing or outsourcing.

We collaboratively design customized engagements - providing the personalization and service of an in-house team, with the scale and expertise of an established institution.

Families gain access to seasoned investment professionals, a network of peers with similar needs, and a firm that never sells products—only advice.

With deep alignment between clients and Greycourt’s owner-employees, co-sourcing ensures control, customization, and continuity without the operational burden or cost of an in-house team.

# What We Do

## We take an integrated, comprehensive approach to managing family wealth.

Matter blends deep financial knowledge and technical expertise with innovative ways of realizing your family’s wealth goals and objectives. We add value by making sure you have the data and expertise to make informed decisions around your wealth and feel confident your family is well prepared for the path ahead.

### We are a true family office.

A multifamily office is more than the sum of its services. Leveraging our interdisciplinary model and breadth of expertise, we address the full complexity of family wealth with consistency, continuity, and customization.

[Learn how we work with families like yours.](https://www.matterfamilyoffice.com/blog/family-office-services/ "")

### Our people-first ethos drives everything we do.

Lasting relationships are built on transparency and trust. We take time to understand your family’s values, aspirations, and definition of success. Then, we build and maintain the right team structure, tools, and expertise to efficiently, effectively support your family’s unique needs and personalities.

[Learn how we build teams.](https://www.matterfamilyoffice.com/blog/how-we-serve-clients-differently/ "")

### Our business model is built for long-term growth (yours, and ours).

For more than three decades, Matter has helped wealthy families thrive. We are committed to being your life-long firm, evolving with you, and serving your family for generations to come. We look forward to helping you navigate your wealth landscape with confidence and embrace the opportunities that lie ahead.

## The Family Office Paradox

**Alone among many.** While the success of your family office confers tremendous opportunities, it also brings complexity. Families of means often juggle multiple professionals to manage their investments, taxes, estate planning, charitable giving, household logistics, and more. Still, no matter how many professionals they hire, the complexities of a family office can make them feel overwhelmed and unsupported.

If the family is supervising a patchwork of disparate professionals, the lack of specialized integration can lead to suboptimal planning and unnecessary stress. That is where the family office advisors at Cerity Partners can help.

## The Solution: Comprehensive Family Office Services

**Support beyond finances.** Cerity Partners Family Office provides a comprehensive suite of services that frees families to focus on what matters most. Our coordinated team of family office advisors is dedicated to preserving, growing, and protecting prosperity. We also serve as the family’s allies and advocates. Whether it’s creating an advanced giving strategy, preparing the next generation to be responsible stewards, optimizing the sale of a business, keeping family meetings productive, or simply saving them time, Cerity Partners’ family office advisors listen attentively and offer sophisticated solutions.

Cerity Partners Family Office can deliver the tools, infrastructure, and specialized knowledge that help the family manage life events and realize critical opportunities.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

### The Family Office Experience: A Customized Approach

Families receive the full breadth and depth of Cerity Partners through highly personalized family office wealth management services from a dedicated team. The family office is customized in various ways, including a family charitable fund, a family LLC investment vehicle, and a family office email address that reaches the entire team and can be used to facilitate communication with other professionals.

Cerity Partners Family Office clients can expect:

#### Thought Leadership

Our firm's experienced family office advisors and technical specialists provide timely insights on the most opportunistic and challenging financial topics of the moment.

#### Exceptional Talent

We attract and retain talented professionals in the wealth management industry. Advisors join Cerity Partners because they passionately believe in our approach.

#### Stewardship

We educate our clients on relevant wealth management issues and solutions, providing full transparency on all terms, risks, and expected outcomes.

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## The Four Pillars of Cerity Partners Family Office

Keeping the family’s financial house in order begins with bringing everything under one roof.

1

### Advanced holistic planning

A truly holistic wealth plan addresses every aspect of your family’s financial well-being and long-term vision. Our services include:

- Legacy planning
- Income tax strategies
- Advanced estate planning
- Trust and fiduciary oversight
- Asset protection and risk management
- Life and business event planning
- Philanthropy
- Family governance and next-generation education
- Transparent, customized reporting

By tailoring every detail to your family’s unique circumstances, we help safeguard your future and preserve your legacy for generations to come.

3

### Trusted guidance and peace of mind

Our dedicated team of seasoned family office professionals provides tailored advice and proactive communication to address your family’s unique needs. With 24/7 access to trusted advisors, we simplify complex financial and lifestyle matters, offering a seamless experience for your family.

Our approach includes:

- Safeguarding wealth, privacy, and legacy
- Anticipating challenges and providing solutions
- Continuously adapting to your evolving goals

With us as your partner, you gain the confidence of knowing that every detail is handled with precision, so your family can focus on what matters most.

2

### Access to sophisticated investments

We design and manage diversified, goal-centered portfolios tailored to your family’s objectives. With access to a broad range of assets and strategies, including exclusive opportunities, we help maximize potential returns.

Our size and scale enable us to:

- Secure lower fees
- Gain exclusive access to unique opportunities
- Negotiate seed economics in select cases

Through careful monitoring, performance benchmarking, and transparent reporting, we deliver market insights and investment solutions that go beyond traditional options—providing the tools your family needs to grow and sustain wealth.

4

### Concierge lifestyle services

Our Family Office is designed to free your family’s time and resources by managing essential life events. Services include:

- **Bill pay:** Collecting, paying, and tracking invoices.
- **Real estate:** Acting as your proxy and managing logistics to ensure privacy.
- **Household employees:** Managing payroll and employee administration.
- **Art advisory:** Providing guidance on art collections.
- **Security:** Protecting your family, home, and digital presence.
- **Private planes, boats, and cars:** Overseeing maintenance for your assets.

By simplifying these complexities, we give your family the freedom to focus on your values, passions, and legacy.

## Getting Started

When we begin a relationship with a new family, we take these key steps:

1

### Getting to know the family

The process starts with a deep dive into your family’s financial landscape and personal dynamics. We evaluate trusts, LLCs, and financial relationships, while also taking the time to understand your family’s priorities, goals, and responsibilities. This holistic approach enables us to craft a personalized client report—a tool that guides decision-making and shapes the strategies to protect and grow your family’s legacy.

2

### Creating an action plan

With the customized client report as our guide, we work with your family to refine priorities, confirm details, and identify opportunities for growth and protection. Together, we design a tailored action plan that aligns with your goals and vision. With a clear strategy in place, we begin implementing solutions and take on the day-to-day responsibilities that simplify your family’s financial life.

3

### Your family office in action

The family office is now fully operational, with our team handling the execution of the action plan while proactively managing your family’s financial responsibilities and day-to-day needs. As life changes, we continuously reassess and refine the plan, ensuring that it remains aligned with your family’s goals. Our focus is on providing unwavering support and simplifying complexities, so your family can focus on pursuing your passions and building a lasting legacy.

### What is the role of a family office, and how can it benefit my family?

A family office offers comprehensive financial, legal, tax, and lifestyle management services designed to simplify your life, preserve your wealth, and provide peace of mind by ensuring you have a dedicated team protecting your interests and advancing your family’s goals.

### How does Cerity Partners Family Office tailor its services to meet the unique needs of each family?

We develop customized strategies by understanding your values, priorities, and long-term goals, offering seamless integration of wealth management, tax planning, estate strategies, and more.

### What should I look for in a family office to ensure my wealth is managed effectively?

Look for a team with personalized service, transparency, and the ability to collaborate across disciplines to holistically manage your financial and personal needs.

### What types of financial and lifestyle challenges can a family office help address?

We handle a wide range of challenges, including investment management, succession planning, tax optimization, real estate management, bill payment, and coordinating family governance.

### How do you work with other advisors, such as attorneys and accountants?

We collaborate closely with your trusted advisors or bring in specialists as needed, ensuring a coordinated approach that aligns with your overarching financial strategy.

### What strategies do you use to help families align their financial goals with their values?

We focus on understanding what matters most to your family, from philanthropy to legacy planning, and design strategies that reflect and uphold those priorities.

### How do you help the next generation prepare for the responsibilities of wealth?

We provide education, mentorship, and family governance guidance to equip future generations with the knowledge and tools they need to manage and sustain wealth responsibly.

# Family Office

What is a Family Office?

A Family Office is a comprehensive suite of services designed to manage all aspects of an affluent family’s financial and personal needs. It combines risk management, financial processing, administration, accounting and tax services, estate planning, and concierge services to provide a holistic approach to wealth management.

![](https://www.whittiertrust.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/cfa1c11d6d9e1b2b26d3d4a44b4968b9-e1741585789164-1024x1019.webp)

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

## Why It Matters:

Wealth brings complexity. Our Family Office Services ensure that your advisors, financial strategy, family dynamics, and legacy planning all align seamlessly. By consolidating resources and expertise, we reduce risk, simplify decision-making, and create a framework for generational success.

[FIND AN ADVISOR](https://www.whittiertrust.com/contact/)

## Our Approach

Learn more about our differentiators.

[EXPLORE OUR OFFICES](https://www.whittiertrust.com/our-offices/)

### Differentiators

Whittier Trust has been delivering Family Office services since 1989, offering unmatched expertise and dedication. Our proactive, integrated approach ensures that your financial life is expertly coordinated, allowing you to focus on what matters most, your family and legacy.

We believe our real estate portfolio management expertise sets us apart from other multi-family offices. However, what truly distinguishes us is the close, trusted relationships we build with our clients. In the most challenging of times, we are there as a trusted partner.

## The Whittier Trust Process:​

![](https://www.whittiertrust.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/DSC5774.webp)

We consolidate a detailed understanding of your balance sheet, estate plans, and family dynamics.

### Overview

At Silvercrest, client relationships begin with listening to your unique story.

We seek to gain an intimate understanding of your individual situation to serve you and your family at the highest level. We collaborate with you to identify your goals and determine your risks, in order to craft a bespoke portfolio strategy designed to protect your capital and accomplish your objectives.

Silvercrest is a pioneer in the wealth management industry, setting the highest standards for independent investment advice and related family office services. We are proud to offer our clients a comprehensive and sophisticated investment solution alongside a level of service that is difficult to obtain elsewhere.

Our investment expertise, combined with our insightful wealth planning and exemplary service, provides an extraordinarily thoughtful and comprehensive private investment management experience. Clients choose Silvercrest for our integrity, consistency, and proven record of success.



### Services for Individuals & Families

Our Services +

## Wealth Management

_Our client-first focus drives our success._

At Silvercrest, portfolio managers work with clients to define long-term wealth management goals and create customized portfolios to achieve them. We reject a one-size-fits-all approach, ensuring each portfolio is tailored to the client’s specific needs. We regularly conduct peer reviews to ensure that each portfolio reflects the firm’s best thinking on markets, asset allocation, and strategy selection.

As a large boutique, we have the scale to attract top talent and the culture to provide personalized service, delivering expert advice directly to each client. Many of our portfolio managers have worked together for over a decade, fostering a collaborative environment that enhances the quality of service clients receive.

We are committed to providing independent, objective advice and believe we will succeed or fail based on the integrity and quality of that guidance.

## Investments

One of Silvercrest’s primary objectives is to deliver excellent investment results by offering a combination of core proprietary investment capabilities complemented by “best-in-class” outsourced capabilities. Silvercrest’s investment capabilities have performed well through past market cycles with appropriate levels of risk and tax efficiency. Our proprietary investment capabilities and outsourced managers are quality-oriented, valuation-sensitive, and highly disciplined with proven investment processes in place. We are also cost-aware, determined to customize a portfolio solution that is as streamlined and cost-effective as possible.

Taken together—and combined with our financial planning, tax expertise and industry-leading consolidated investment reporting—we believe our capabilities offer the right combination of ingredients to help our clients successfully achieve their long-term financial objectives.

## Your Values Matter at Silvercrest

Each client’s distinctive values and objectives matter to us. With two decades of experience and significant resources in place, your Silvercrest portfolio managers are prepared to implement a customized investment plan tailored to achieve your financial objectives while expressing the environmental, social and governance values important to you.

A proliferation of novel terms clouds what has been a part of Silvercrest’s investment capabilities since its founding twenty years ago. Whether you choose to call it Socially Responsible Investing, Mission-Aligned Investing, ESG, or Impact, Silvercrest stands ready with robust Values-Based investment options.

Silvercrest’s Values-Based Investment Committee has carefully crafted opportunities ranging from negatively screening out undesired securities to selecting high-quality proprietary and best-in-class external managers and funds that highlight and support the values that matter most to you. Importantly, these sophisticated capabilities exist across all areas of the firm, being available to individuals & families, institutional equity clients and endowments & foundations. ## Family Office Services

Beyond traditional investment management, Silvercrest’s Family Office Services provide a wide range of solutions tailored to the needs of each client. Its capabilities include coordinated estate and wealth planning, financial and income tax planning, consolidated reporting and personal accounting solutions. Utilizing the Family Office Services team allows our clients to focus on what is truly important to them. At Silvercrest, it is our goal to provide clients with a comprehensive wealth management platform at the highest levels of professionalism, integrity, and efficiency.

### Tax & Financial Planning

Our objective is to maximize after-tax family wealth. Working alongside the investment management process, our in-house team of tax and financial planning specialists seeks to provide innovative solutions through careful analysis, including payment planning and tracking.

### Wealth Reporting

Provide a holistic view of a family’s entire balance sheet, with cash flow and expense reporting, consolidated with portfolio and asset allocation reports.

### Administrative Services

Alleviate burdens of managing day-to-day personal financial activities including accounting, bill paying, cash management, budgeting, record keeping, and financial statement reporting.

## Family Business Advisory Services

The Family Business Advisory Group provides Silvercrest with the in-house corporate finance and related services capability to help family business owners navigate the complex and often sensitive issues associated with strategic initiatives, liquidity events and ensuring the family business legacy. Family businesses are often a family’s largest asset, as well as the most important contributor to their wealth creation. For family business owners, many of the most pressing concerns focus on either corporate finance transactions or business succession planning/stewardship. Through 17-plus years of working with family businesses of all sizes and across a wide array of industries, our Family Business Advisory Group has had the opportunity to work with over 600 family business situations regarding the corporate advisory capabilities outlined below. In working with family businesses, Silvercrest is committed to providing a long-term trusted advisor relationship with the family and the business.

### Business Advisory Services

### Corporate Finance Advisory

Many liquidity alternatives are available to family business owners and their companies, including deploying cash flow, leveraging the balance sheet, and selling equity. In a liquidity event, your Family Business Advisor can help a family business identify and select the appropriate investment bank or boutique advisory firm to assist with the transaction and help ensure a successful outcome.

### Access to Capital

Additional capital may be required to fund growth or defend a family company’s market position. By analyzing the stage of growth and size of the company, your Family Business Advisor can help determine the appropriate financing strategy and the optimal blend of debt and equity capital to finance growth and help achieve the family business owner’s objectives.

### Succession Planning

In order to promote the family business legacy, it is vital that the family business owner has a succession plan in place. Thoughtful leadership and ownership succession planning promotes a smooth transition, ensuring stability and continuity. It is a critical investment in the future success of any family business.

We encourage clients to think about how their assets could meet the purpose of their wealth to: ## Protect To meet expenditure ## Grow For the long term ## Enjoy Properties and other assets #### INVESTMENT COMMITTEE * * * ## Investment strategy recommendations are guided by our investment committee. We look for managers where the strategy is conducted within an operational framework which is robust and fit for purpose. ![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/689882cbd42f093625700541/c0959aeb-02d5-42ae-b915-2bc75e618ce1/unsplash-image-kZTYGpoeQO0.jpg) ## “Wren’s personal and friendly approach, their professional and _meticulous attention_ to detail and comprehensive knowledge of the vast subject of investments is _highly appreciated_ by us. ## Unsere Historie

##### Durch Fleiß, durch gute Ideen und durch richtige Entscheidungen haben sich unsere Gesellschafter ein Vermögen aufgebaut, das diese erhalten und vermehren möchten, ohne es zu riskieren. Auch die Prinzipien unseres Family Office basieren daher auf einer tief verwurzelten unternehmerischen Tradition.

Slide 1 of 8

1823

##### Entwicklung zum Chemieunternehmen

Johann Adam Benckiser erwirbt eine Salmiakhütte und entwickelt sie zusammen mit seinem Schwiegersohn und Chemiker Dr. Ludwig Reimann zu einem Chemieunternehmen.

![](https://images.prismic.io/reimann/c710ded5-eeac-46c4-98f5-47a798847546_JAB+und+LR.png?auto=compress%2Cformat&dpr=2&fit=max&w=3840&q=80)

1932

##### Vermarktung Calgon

Unter der Leitung von Dr. Albert Reimann jun. lizenziert und vermarktet Benckiser Calgon.

1982

##### Neupositionierung als Markenkonzern

Benckiser verändert seine Unternehmensstruktur und formt sich mittels Akquisitionen und Innovationen zu einem reinen Markenartikelkonzern für Waschen, Spülen und Reinigen.

1992

##### Übernahme Coty Inc.

Benckiser übernimmt Coty Inc., den heute führenden Hersteller von Düften, die in über 130 Ländern vertrieben werden. Die Benckiser-Gruppe hat 100 Tochtergesellschaften weltweit und beschäftigt über 10.000 Mitarbeiter. Mit einem Jahresumsatz von 4,5 Mrd. DM gehört der Konzern zu Deutschlands führenden Unternehmen.

1999

##### Fusion mit Reckitt & Colman

Durch die Fusion mit dem englischen Unternehmen Reckitt & Colman wird das Unternehmen Reckitt Benckiser geschaffen, das zum maßgeblichen Hersteller von Wasch-, Putz- und Reinigungsmitteln avanciert. Ende der 1990er-Jahre trennen sich Mitglieder der Familie Reimann von ihrer Beteiligung am früheren Familienunternehmen und stehen vor der Herausforderung, liquides Vermögen nach bewährten unternehmerischen Prinzipien zu investieren.

2006

##### Gründung Family Office Reimann Investors

Einzelne Familienmitglieder kommen zu dem Ergebnis, dass man nur mit einer selbst geschaffenen Organisation und einem eigenen Asset-Management den persönlichen finanziellen Kriterien und Wertvorstellungen gerecht werden kann.

![](https://reimann.cdn.prismic.io/reimann/87af1f6c-8b7d-4462-ad38-5d5e0d1b0473_Reimann+Investors+169+%281%29.svg?dpr=2&fit=max&w=3840&q=80)

2009

##### Öffnung der Kapitalmarktanlage

Anleger außerhalb der Familie erhalten die Möglichkeit, am bewährten Investitionskonzept der Familienmitglieder zu partizipieren und ihr Vermögen in gleicher Weise am Kapitalmarkt anzulegen.

2017

##### Öffnung der unternehmerischen Direktbeteiligungen

Unternehmerisch denkende Anleger können gemeinsam mit Reimann Investors in wachstumsstarke Digitalunternehmen investieren.

## Unsere Investmentbereiche

##### Unsere Besonderheit ist die Fokussierung auf das für uns Wesentliche: Kapitalmarktinvestitionen und Unternehmensbeteiligungen. Dadurch können wir Ressourcen und Wachsamkeit auf diese eine Aufgabe konzentrieren und unser Know-how optimal einsetzen. So können wir schnell fundierte Entscheidungen treffen und tatkräftig handeln.

[**Kapital­markt** \\
\\
Unsere liquiden Kapitalmarktinvestitionen zielen darauf ab, das investierte Kapital langfristig für zukünftige Generationen zu mehren.](https://www.reimann-investors.com/family-office/kapitalmarkt)

[**Unternehmens­beteiligungen** \\
\\
Bei unseren Unternehmensbeteiligungen konzentrieren wir uns auf stark wachsende Technologiefirmen aus den Bereichen Software as a Service (SaaS), Fintech und Ecomtech.](https://www.reimann-investors.com/family-office/unternehmensbeteiligungen)

## Anleger­gemeinschaft

##### Ausgewählten Kunden bieten wir die Möglichkeit, ihr Vermögen analog zu den vom Family Office Reimann Investors betreuten Familienmitgliedern anzulegen. Für Sie gelten die gemeinsamen Grundsätze und Ziele, Sorgfaltspflichten und Kostenvorteile. Wenn Sie Teil unserer Anlegergemeinschaft werden wollen, so möchten wir Sie einladen, mit uns in Verbindung zu treten und unsere Ziele, Werte und Anlageperspektiven näher kennenzulernen.

###### Marinya Capital

# Investment Strategy

Marinya is a beta constrained, global concentrated long equity investor.

Marinya typically has 10 to 15 public and private long equity positions that make up the majority of our assets; we have a small portfolio of managers to provide diversification and deal flow; and we hold the balance in cash to support our hedging activities and provide flexibility.

Marinya is very macro aware. We manage our equity beta within a range of 0.2 to 0.7 and we move our beta within this range actively as our views on risk change. We also actively manage our currency portfolio for diversification and alpha purposes and from time to time we hedge rates and other macro risks.

[Terms & Disclosures](https://pathstone.com/terms-disclosures/) [General Inquiries](https://pathstone.com/#) [Privacy Policy](https://pathstone.com/privacy-policy/)

![Hero Image](https://pathstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/individual-3.jpg)![Hero Image](https://pathstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/individual-3.jpg)

## On building   a preferred life.

Wealth may open up possibility.

And wealth may also complicate a life.

We work with hundreds of families. Families who have shaped entire industries, birthed companies, supported communities, invested in vital infrastructure, pioneered brands, created films and culture and music. Not all are famous or household names; they prefer to do this work quietly, intensely, sometimes quite privately. The accumulated experiences, lessons, and foresight gleaned from working with such families is the source of our collective wisdom—and what we can bring to your family.

The one common thread in this uncommon group: each brings the wealth of their own story.

## How?

By pursuing their preferred life—the life they yearn for, dream about, hope for—often in ways that extend beyond what they once imagined. And for many, it may include building preferred lives for others—family, future generations, employees, neighbors, alma maters.

One of our greatest privileges—and we do mean that sincerely—is to strive to walk alongside families as they navigate the essential work of shaping their lives and the impact they want those lives to have. Through years of experience, we have come to recognize the patterns, challenges, and opportunities that arise on the journey toward what we call a preferred life. We offer perspective in pivotal decisions. We help coordinate the many moving parts of financial life so families can devote more of their time and energy to what matters most. We seek to bring together systems, professional partners, and thoughtful conversations to support families across generations.

With resourcefulness, foresight, and deep empathy, we strive to be a steady presence—through both moments of celebration and moments of challenge. That might mean guiding financial planning when a new company is launched or sold, helping families prepare for the joy and responsibility of welcoming children or grandchildren, supporting transitions such as career reinventions or second chapters, or being a trusted resource when families face difficult circumstances such as health issues or the loss of a loved one. And in between these defining events, we remain present for the ongoing calls, planning sessions, and thoughtful discussions that give families clarity and confidence. When you think in terms of generations, life feels long. When you realize the impact you want to make—and how precious time is—life also feels short. We consider it our role to help families use that time with intention, clarity, and confidence.

## What motivates us at Pathstone?

To be in service of your preferred life—as deeply as our trusted relationship allows, and in all the ways we can contribute. Serving as a fiduciary is not a choice but a legal responsibility—one we honor with the utmost seriousness. What motivates Pathstone is how we live that duty because it’s what our clients deserve: with empathy, foresight, and resourcefulness, always seeking to align our work with what matters most to you.

### Dave's Preferred Life: Rebuilding a Town\*

Dave has decided it’s time to spend down a significant portion of his wealth. But he doesn’t want to simply give it away. He wants to help revitalize a town in the region where he grew up—a place that had seen families and opportunity vanish as industry changed.

\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Our partnership

In this case, our aim would be to work closely with Dave to chart a long-term trajectory, structuring his giving through non-traditional assets—including real estate, operating businesses, and a foundation—to transform illiquidity into opportunity. And, along the way, help him assemble talent, connect with experts, and adjust the plan as the vision evolves—building an economic engine where one hasn’t existed for years.
\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Zane’s Preferred Life: Life After an Exit\*

Zane has built and sold his company, cashing out a life’s work, but faces the challenge of translating that lump-sum gain into a new chapter: relocating to remote New Zealand, buying his dream country home, and funding a wilderness-based lifestyle without jeopardizing his long-term security.

\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Our partnership

In this case, our aim would be to structure and optimize his sale to maximize after-tax proceeds, model cash flows to fund his New Zealand home and living expenses, and coordinate U.S. and Kiwi entities, banking, and insurance. Alongside his move, we would seek to provide ongoing portfolio governance, concierge support for property setup, and strategic coaching—helping Zane embrace his wild-country vision with confidence and stability.
\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Jill’s Preferred Life: Life after Dissolution\*

Jill is navigating a painful divorce. While her equity in a pre-IPO company has significant value on paper, it remains illiquid—and now, she is solely responsible for her financial future. She wants to stay invested in her work, but in the short term, she faces mounting legal fees, living costs, and deep uncertainty.

\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Our partnership

In this case, our aim would be to help Jill unlock near-term liquidity, model settlement scenarios to preserve future upside, and structure her finances to help avoid forced sales or tax missteps. In close coordination with her legal counsel, we’d aim to help Jill quietly build a bridge to stability—protecting her vision and preparing for what comes next.
\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Maria’s Preferred Life: Passing the Baton\*

Maria, a long-time family matriarch, has spent decades building and nurturing her company and multi-asset estate, yet now faces the emotional and logistical challenge of handing control to her three adult children while preserving family harmony and wealth.

\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

### Our partnership

In this case, our aim would be guide Maria through crafting a family constitution and advisory board charter, structure purpose-driven trusts to fund next-gen opportunities, and design a bespoke governance framework that balances decision rights between Maria and her heirs. Through workshops, coaching, and legal/tax structuring, we would seek to ensure a seamless transition—helping to protect her legacy, empower her children, and cement the family’s shared vision for generations to come.
\*Scenarios scenariod above are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual Pathstone clients or outcomes.

# At Pathstone, we’re    seeking to redefine what it means to be a modern advisor.

At Pathstone, we aim to deliver a fully integrated advisory platform that marries a broad and deep investment offering with a wide range of professional services, customized to meet the needs of individuals, families, family offices, and institutions—all through one integrated national team.

#### With Pathstone, you get:

- An investment offering that includes deep research, independent sourcing, and rigorous oversight. Our approach seeks to combine diverse market access, scale, and agility with the aim of supporting your values, goals, and risk profile.
- Breadth of services\*—from strategic tax and estate planning to complex trust structuring, fiduciary oversight, generational governance, education, philanthropic design, and more. We help clients live into their intent, manage complexity, and build enduring legacies.
- Meaningful integration, not just coordination. With investment, planning, operations, and professional services all under one roof, we seek to create efficiency, clarity, and momentum across many dimensions of your life, family office, or institution.
- A distinctive culture focused on cultivating relationships that last. In the moments that matter, we seek to embody foresight, empathy, resourcefulness, accompaniment, and performance. It’s not just what we do—it’s how we aim to show up in moments that matter to you.

#### Distinctive, by design

We are privately held, with leadership and key professionals invested in the long-term success of the firm and the families and institutions we serve. That structure supports our independence of thought, alignment with client outcomes, and a culture grounded in service—not selling.

We aim to build enduring relationships—with a commitment to insight, excellence, and results that speak for themselves.

\\* Pathstone will act solely in its capacity as a registered investment advisor and does not provide legal advice. Although Pathstone can provide accounting and tax services, the client should seek the counsel of a qualified accountant and/or attorney when necessary. Pathstone may assist clients with tax harvesting, and we will work with a client’s tax specialist to answer any questions related to the client’s portfolio account.

## Get to Know Family Office & Private Wealth Management

What is a Family Office?

A family office is a private advisory firm that manages the full range of a family’s financial needs, including investments, estate planning, and philanthropy. Its goal is to grow, protect, and transfer wealth across generations through a holistic, personalized approach.

What is Private Wealth Management?

Private wealth management offers tailored financial services for high-net-worth individuals, covering investments, tax planning, and estate strategies. It helps optimize and preserve wealth through a personalized, integrated approach.

Is Private Wealth Management Right for Me?

If your finances are complex and you value thoughtful, personalized guidance, private wealth management may be a good fit. It offers strategic support to help you make confident, informed financial decisions.
